title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Get answers to the most common questions about our German courses and learning process.

items.question: Can I get a trial class before enrolling?
items.answer: Refund terms depend on the course, batch start date, and classes attended. Contact our admissions team for details before enrolling.

items.question: How long does it take to complete a course?
items.answer: Course duration depends on the level. A1 typically takes 8–12 weeks, while higher levels may take longer with regular live classes and practice.

items.question: Do you provide certificates upon completion?
items.answer: Yes. Students receive a course completion certificate from Fluent AUF, and we also prepare you for official Goethe and Telc certifications.

items.question: What is your refund policy?
items.answer: Refund terms depend on the course, batch start date, and classes attended. Contact our admissions team for details before enrolling.
